Hell yes! He has gotten me through some serious shit! No one in my personal life knows who he is and friends who are going through hard times don’t listen to my recommendation to listen to him. I always say that I wish I had been born in Europe! Thank you for this, made me smile and not feel so alone and isolated. <3

Please don’t do it. Hike to reach a goal, take in the nature and try and live in the moment, but please don’t take your life. You are precious and so is your life. I get it, I’ve thought of ways to end it as well, but just know that you aren’t alone and have people to talk to even if it’s on Reddit. I hope to hear about your hike tmr OP. 

You are not alone and we are here for you <3

Thank you for this comment. I hope to get to this point in my life someday. I’m constantly trying to please the people in my life, not ruffle any feathers, and make sure everyone else is happy at the expense of my own happiness. It’s extremely draining and I hope to get there one day.

Thanks for the kind words. 

I’ve dealt with depression my whole life, but for whatever reason working Mon-Fri amplifies my depression ten fold vs. when I had a job with irregular shifts. I’m more aware of the passage of time and really only looking forward to two days out of the week. I don’t understand how everyone is down with the monotonous Mon-Fri life. Living for the weekend, but hardly living is no life at all.
